w: Swamishri established a Yuvak Mandal in Harare.
Grand welcome at airport. Minister for Tourism and Wildlife, Hon. Henry Kosagi, welcomed Swamishri.
ph: Welcomed at the old Swaminarayan mandir, Nagara road, Nairobi, 21 Aug 99

w: In the evening assembly the local balaks enacted the transformation of Shitaldas on seeing Shriji Maharaj's divinity. Then a balak performed a dance with dishes in hand. And lastly, a balak performed a mono-acting on the transformation of Magniram. Swamishri finally appreciated the performances and blessed the assembly.
Mayur, the son of Tarunbhai who had come from London, was leaving today. Mayur, who is very lovingly attached to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, asked Swamishri, "When will we meet again?"

Swamishri said, "We are always together. When we remember, we are together. See how instantly things appear on the internet! In the same way, we too should chant Swaminarayan... Swaminarayan..., and he will appear instantly."
A devotee had come with a question written on a note. He had written, "If someone remembers you in their mind, do you answer them?"
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "God certainly answers whoever remembers him."
Mayur, the son of Tarunbhai, who had come from London, was taking leave today. Mayur, who is lovingly attached to Pramukh Swami Maharaj, asked Swamishri, "When will we meet again?"

Swamishri said, "We are always together. When we remember, we are together. How instantly things appear on the Internet! In the same way, if we chant Swaminarayan... Swaminarayan..., he appears instantly."
A devotee had come with a question written on a slip of paper. He had written, "If someone remembers you in their mind, do you answer them?"
Pramukh Swami Maharaj said, "Whoever remembers Bhagwan, he certainly answers them."
Today before the shangar arti, the sadhus from Canada came to Mahant Swami Maharaj to take leave. They were now returning to Canada. They asked, "What message should we give the devotees?"
"Unity."
Thus in a single word Swamishri told his wish, his secret and his opinion.

Today, after the midday meal, Mr Jiruwala, a gentleman of the Dawoodi Bohra community, came to meet Mahant Swami Maharaj. He was very happy to have Swamishri's darshan. Taking Swamishri's hands in his own, he said, "Ever since I heard the news about Swamibapa, I had been restless. Today I will now be able to sleep peacefully." Then, revealing the reason, he said, "Great souls never die. They always remain immortal. I am convinced that today that great soul, Pramukh Swami Maharaj, is present in you."
Swamishri's presence does not let the absence of Pramukh Swami Maharaj be felt. He is giving everyone in their hearts the experience of Swamibapa's manifest presence.
This evening, when Mahant Swami Maharaj finished his walk, an enthusiastic devotee called out, "Pragat Brahmaswarup Mahant Swami Maharaj ni jai." All the devotees took up this cry loudly.
But hearing this, Swamishri at once stopped and had the sadhus convey, "Tell them first to call out Pramukh Swami Maharaj's jai, and only then anyone else's."
Always considering oneself less than the guru, always remaining his servant: today everyone saw this way of the Gunatit gurus in Swamishri too.

Today there was a solar eclipse. Even before leaving his room to go to the place of puja, Mahant Swami Maharaj had given a clear and strict instruction: "If I do not have breakfast for one day, am I going to die?" Then, coming onto the puja stage, he again said to his attendant, "After puja, no breakfast and no juice either. We will take only water..."

In fact, according to the scriptural rules of the eclipse, those who are ill, weak or over 80 years old may eat up to three hours before the eclipse begins. Accordingly, Swamishri could have had breakfast and so on until 8.30. The sadhus had also requested this, but their request bore no fruit.
Truly, it is the great sadhu who keeps alive certain rites and rules, such as those of the eclipse.

Today the eclipse began at 11.30. Mahant Swami Maharaj came to the assembly right from the start. Then, pleased, Swamishri showered blessings, saying, "If you were given ten million dollars and asked in return to do something, would you do it or not? In the same way, seeing divinity is worth ten million, a billion, a trillion dollars. We must understand the glory. These are Bhagwan's words. No argument. Just as when someone gives you ten million dollars there is no argument, and you dance and jump as the giver makes you, so too, if you keep the sense of divinity, Shriji Maharaj will take you to Akshardham at rocket speed, at the speed of Akshardham.
We have met such a Shriji Maharaj, Gunatitanand Swami and the great sadhu, the gateway to moksha; if we join ourselves to them, there is no more coming and going. Akshardham is right here."

Today, because of the eclipse, even at the age of 83, Mahant Swami Maharaj did not put a single grain of food in his mouth from morning until 4.00 in the afternoon. And during this eclipse assembly, Swamishri signed 150 letters and turned 170 malas. After the assembly, Swamishri did puja according to Shriji Maharaj's command.
Then Swamishri said, "I enjoyed it."
The sadhus asked, "What?"
Swamishri said, "My stomach stayed empty!"
Truly, the ways of a true sadhu are "different from the world."
